svg.aria-label: Grouse near Mission. Strategy is opinion. Grouse, to 15 December: Where Ruffed in aspen and poplar near water; sooty in conifers, often higher in winter (65 to 85%). How Walk a Forest Service road edge at first light, then step off the road to shoot (Tip).
svg.text: Strategy is opinion. Each line says Tip or gives its source.
